title: Vintage Oil Derrick Rig in Rural Field, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-20th century black and white snapshot capturing an oil derrick rig and industrial smoke stacks operating in a rural landscape beyond a barbed wire fence. The presence of Spanish moss draped from trees on the left suggests a location in the Southern United States, likely during the mid-century petroleum expansion in states such as Texas or Louisiana. The reverse side features a brief handwritten note in blue ink reading 'Same thing'.
